item.title: CVE-2026-28912: MacOS PackageKit Symlink Following Privilege Escalation
item.description:
Introduction

In 2026, Apple patched CVE-2026-28912, a vulnerability in macOS PackageKit that allowed a malicious .pkg to write files as root to paths it never declared. The advisory was brief: “A user may be able to elevate privileges.”

The original discovery is credited to Matej Moravec(@MacejkoMoravec).

What the advisory didn’t say was how it worked. No public technical writeup existed. So I sat down with the 26.4 and 26.6 binaries, opened Hopper, and reverse-engineered it myself. This post is the result.
